article.headline: Posey puts up 22 as UT Rio Grande Valley downs Prairie View A&M 68-63
article.description: — Jace Posey had 22 points in UT Rio Grande Valley’s 68-63 victory against Prairie View A&M on Saturday.
article.linkText: Posey puts up 22 as UT Rio Grande Valley downs Prairie View A&M 68-63

categories.description: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ UT Rio Grande Valley Vaqueros

event.description: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ UT Rio Grande Valley Vaqueros

keywords: Prairie View A&M Panthers @ UT Rio Grande Valley Vaqueros
article.story: EDINBURG, Texas -- — Jace Posey had 22 points in UT Rio Grande Valley’s 68-63 victory against Prairie View A&M on Saturday. Posey also contributed nine rebounds for the Vaqueros (2-0). B.B. Knight scored 14 points, shot 2 for 7 from beyond the arc and 8 of 11 from the free-throw line. Devon Pryor had 13 points and shot 4 of 12 from the field and went 5 for 6 from the line. Davis Bynum led the way for the Panthers (2-1) with 26 points, 12 rebounds and three blocks. Prairie View A&M also got 14 points from Anthony Gause. Micah Bell finished with nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
